home.intro: AI-Group Software and Networks Algorithms LLC is a Bellevue, Washington company founded in 2023, serving clients in every country. We build software the way a security team would want it built: threat-modeled before the first line of code, tested before it ships, and monitored after it goes live. We work in English, French, Portuguese, and Spanish with individuals, startups, small businesses, corporations, nonprofits, and educational organizations.
why: Every engagement begins with threat modeling and ends with security testing. Cybersecurity is our founding discipline, not an add-on.
You work with senior engineers who hold CISSP, CCSP, PCNSE, and AWS Solutions Architect Professional certifications, not a sales layer.
Requirements, documentation, and support in English, French, Portuguese, or Spanish, so nothing is lost in translation.
Modular, API-first architecture that scales from a first release to thousands of users without a rewrite.
caps: Secure development, application and API security, cloud security, vulnerability management, detection engineering, incident response solutions, and zero-trust architecture.
AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud: migration, Kubernetes, serverless, infrastructure as code with Terraform, CI/CD, backup and disaster recovery.
AI assistants, retrieval-augmented knowledge systems, workflow automation, document processing, and AI security automation, built with AI treated as an untrusted subsystem.

security.sub: How we build, and what we protect against.
principles: OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10
Secrets in managed vaults, never in code
security.controlsTitle: Controls in every system we deliver
controls: Password hashing with Argon2id or bcrypt, MFA, session management, protection against credential stuffing and account enumeration.
Role-based access control checked server-side. Tenant isolation tested, with PostgreSQL row-level security where appropriate.
TLS 1.2+ everywhere, encryption at rest, key management with cloud KMS, UTC timestamps, decimal money types.
Input validation, output encoding, CSRF protection, security headers, rate limiting, and safe file handling with malware scanning.
AI treated as an untrusted subsystem: limited tools, prompt-injection defenses, no cross-customer data, no AI-authored prices or commitments.
Structured logging without secrets, tamper-resistant audit logs, tested backups, and documented recovery with defined RPO and RTO.
security.disclosure: If you believe you have found a security issue in one of our systems, please email us with the details. We acknowledge reports promptly and will not pursue action against good-faith researchers.

body: What we collect

When you contact us or submit a project request, we collect the information you provide: name, email, phone, company, country, preferred language, and project details. This website does not use advertising trackers.
Why we use it
To respond to your request, prepare proposals, and deliver services. We do not sell personal data.
Storage and security
Messages are transmitted over HTTPS. Request data is stored in our business systems with access limited to staff who need it.
Your rights

You may ask us to access, correct, or delete your personal data by emailing us. Depending on your country of residence, applicable law may give you additional rights; we honor those requests where they apply.
Cookies
This site stores only your language preference in your browser. No analytics or marketing cookies are set without consent.
Compliance note

We design with GDPR and the privacy laws applicable in each country where our clients operate in mind. We do not claim certification under any regime until legal and technical verification is complete.
Use of this website
Content on this site is provided for information about our services. It does not constitute a contractual offer, a price, or a guarantee.
Project requests
Submitting a request does not create an engagement. Work begins only under a signed agreement describing scope, price, and terms.
